天无日月星，地无灯火明。
昏暗的世界里，山河干枯，一片荒芜。
呼啸的冷风如野兽的低吼，传出“呜呜”声，不断掠夺着这片苍凉大地上本就不多的温度，近乎成了一片霜土，举目远望，皆是末日景象。
有一行三人，他们身披粗布衣，正躲在一座光秃秃的矮丘后。
此刻的陈风奇，有些郁闷，没想到自己第一次外出探索，就被人给挟持了。
在他的身旁，是一对手持刀刃，看上去三十岁左右的中年男女。
那男子的手正搭在他的肩上，让他感觉像是扛了一块巨石，连呼吸都变困难了。
“小子，你很清楚，我二人若想杀你，你逃不掉。所以别想耍花招，老老实实去将那株宝药采来，保准给你留条活路。”男子咧着嘴笑道。
陈风奇微微抬头，看向矮丘前方大概二三十丈远，一株生长在荒地上氤氲着三尺灵光的小草，心中不禁叹息。
这是完全不给他活路啊！
在这片腐朽的大地上，存在了宝药的地方，往往有异兽潜伏在地底。
中年男子的意思已经很明显，是想让他去当诱饵吸引异兽，好趁机夺取宝药。
而以陈风奇那区区凝气二层的修为，哪怕是最弱小的异兽，也不是他所能应付的。
中年男子却不管那么多，搭在他肩头的手一推，就逼着他去。
他被推得一个踉跄，可并没有立刻行动，反而回头看向男子，叹气道：“让我去也行，但赤手空拳，我可挡不住异兽，总得给件兵器防身吧，不然与让我去送死有什么区别？”
一旁女子闻言皱眉，道：“你没有讨价还价的资格，不去老娘现在就了结你。”
陈风奇干脆破罐破摔，走到男子面前，闭上双眼，梗着脖子。
“那你们动手吧，横竖都是个死，与其死在异兽口中，不如让你们来个痛快的。”
女子心头一怒，正欲有所动作，却被男子抬手制止。

男子在微微犹豫后，从怀中掏出一把短刃递了出去。
“拿着。”
陈风奇睁眼，将短刃接过，拿在手里握了握，并非凡品，感觉还不错。
男子眯眼看着他，继续说道：“再说一遍，你最好别耍花招……”
可他话还没说完，就听“噗嗤”一声，让他整个人一顿，瞳孔随之骤凝。
当他缓缓低头时，才发现自己刚递出去的那柄短刃，此刻已经刺入他的腹部。
不仅是他，就连一旁的女子都没有想到，之前一路上表现都极为老实的陈风奇，会突然冷不丁来上这么一刀。
尤其是双方的距离太近，根本来不及反应。
短暂的错愕之后，就是剧烈的疼痛与无边的怒火。
可陈风奇在完成出刀的瞬间，脚步就已经动了。
他为了更快远离，出刀后甚至没有抽刀的动作，直接松手，趁着两人还处于惊愕之际，全力运转修为越过矮丘，朝宝药的方向跑去。
“该死！”
男子面色一片铁青，伸手抓住了想要追过去的女子，道：“别急，他逃不掉！”
言罢，男子忍痛将腹部的短刃抽出，运转修为止血，目光却死死盯着陈风奇，带着强烈杀意。
陈风奇当然知道，这一刀不足以要了中年男子的命。
他其实是想照着对方脑门捅的，可惜没什么机会。
那对男女的修为，应该都是凝气三层，陈风奇想就这么逃肯定也行不通，会被追上。
所以他才跑向了宝药所在的方向，想要尝试借异兽脱身。
在修为的加持下，他迅捷如风，二三十丈的距离很快接近。
可忽然之间，宝药一旁的荒地骤然炸裂，有异兽身影破土而出，带着尖锐嘶鸣，就朝他扑杀而来。

这还是陈风奇第一次面对异兽，霎时瞪大了双眼。
但见其身高八尺，细长干瘦，通体漆黑，形如鬼魅，有着四条长长的手臂，与一张血盆大口，看上去可怕狰狞。
特别是异兽所散发的那股凶戾气息，让他忍不住汗毛倒竖。
好在他做好了心理准备，虽惊不乱，忽然抬手从自己的身上撕下一块破布。
那破布在被撕下的瞬间，竟飞速变大，在他挥手之间，已将扑来异兽裹在其中。
content_en:
;;
There is no sun, moon or stars in the sky, and there are no lights on the earth.
In the dim world, the mountains and rivers are dry and desolate.
呼啸的冷风如野兽的低吼，传出“呜呜”声，不断掠夺着这片苍凉大地上本就不多的温度，近乎成了一片霜土，举目远望，皆是末日景象。
There was a group of three people, dressed in coarse cloth, hiding behind a bare low hill.
At this moment, Chen Fengqi was a little depressed. He didn't expect that he would be kidnapped for the first time when he went out to explore.
Beside him were a pair of middle-aged men and women in their thirties, holding blades.
The man's hand was on his shoulder, making him feel like he was carrying a huge boulder, making it difficult to breathe.
“小子，你很清楚，我二人若想杀你，你逃不掉。所以别想耍花招，老老实实去将那株宝药采来，保准给你留条活路。”男子咧着嘴笑道。
Chen Fengqi raised his head slightly and looked at a small grass growing on the wasteland about twenty or thirty feet away in front of the short hill with a three-foot spiritual light, and he couldn't help but sigh in his heart.
This is completely giving him no way to survive!
In this decaying land, where there are precious medicines, there are often strange beasts lurking underground.
The middle-aged man's intention was obvious. He wanted him to be used as a bait to attract strange beasts, so that he could seize the precious medicine.
And with Chen Fengqi's mere second-level cultivation of Qi Condensation, even the weakest alien beasts are not something he can handle.
The middle-aged man didn't care so much. He put his hand on his shoulder and pushed him, forcing him to go.
他被推得一个踉跄，可并没有立刻行动，反而回头看向男子，叹气道：“让我去也行，但赤手空拳，我可挡不住异兽，总得给件兵器防身吧，不然与让我去送死有什么区别？”
The woman on the side frowned when she heard this and said: "You are not qualified to bargain. If you don't go, I will kill you now."
Chen Fengqi simply broke the pot, walked up to the man, closed his eyes, and held his neck.
"Then go ahead and do it. You're going to die anyway. Rather than die in the mouth of a strange beast, it's better for you to have a good time."
The woman was furious and was about to take action, but the man raised his hand to stop her.
After a slight hesitation, the man took out a short blade from his arms and handed it over.
"Take it."
Chen Fengqi opened his eyes, took the short blade, held it in his hand and shook it. It was not a special item, it felt pretty good.
The man narrowed his eyes at him and continued: "Again, you'd better not play tricks..."
But before he finished speaking, he heard a "puff" sound, which made his whole body pause, and his pupils suddenly condensed.
When he slowly lowered his head, he realized that the short blade he had just handed out had already pierced his abdomen.
Not only him, but also the woman beside him did not expect that Chen Fengqi, who had been extremely honest along the way, would suddenly attack him like this out of the blue.
Especially since the distance between the two parties was too close, there was no time to react.
After a brief period of shock, there was severe pain and boundless anger.
But the moment Chen Fengqi finished drawing the sword, his steps were already moving.
他为了更快远离，出刀后甚至没有抽刀的动作，直接松手，趁着两人还处于惊愕之际，全力运转修为越过矮丘，朝宝药的方向跑去。
"Damn it!"
The man's face turned livid, he reached out and grabbed the woman who was trying to chase her, and said, "Don't worry, he can't escape!"
After saying that, the man reluctantly pulled out the short blade from his abdomen and used it to stop the bleeding, but his eyes were fixed on Chen Fengqi with strong murderous intent.
Of course Chen Fengqi knew that this knife was not enough to kill the middle-aged man.
He actually wanted to stab the other person in the forehead, but unfortunately he didn't have a chance.
The cultivation level of the man and woman should be at the third level of Qi Condensation. Chen Fengqi would definitely not be able to escape like this and would be caught up.
So he ran towards the direction of the treasure medicine, wanting to taste it试借异兽脱身。
With the blessing of his cultivation, he was as fast as the wind, and he quickly approached the distance of twenty or thirty feet.
But suddenly, the wasteland next to Baoyao suddenly exploded, and a strange beast emerged from the ground, with a sharp hiss, and rushed towards him.
This was the first time Chen Fengqi faced a strange beast, and his eyes widened instantly.
但见其身高八尺，细长干瘦，通体漆黑，形如鬼魅，有着四条长长的手臂，与一张血盆大口，看上去可怕狰狞。
Especially the ferocious aura exuded by the alien beasts made his hair stand on end.
Fortunately, he was mentally prepared. Although he was frightened, he suddenly raised his hand and tore off a rag from his body.
The moment the rag was torn off, it quickly grew in size, and before he waved his hand, the attacking beast was wrapped in it.
